faq.a1: Yes. Upgrade, downgrade or cancel at any time from your settings. Changes apply at the start of your next billing period.
faq.q2: Do individual course purchases still work?
faq.a2: Absolutely. You can buy any single course and keep it forever, with or without a subscription.
faq.q3: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a3: All major credit and debit cards. Business customers can also pay by invoice. All prices are in US dollars.
faq.a4: No. Learnora is a demo project, so checkout is simulated and no card is ever charged.
